title: Taurus–Littrow

frame.note: Local true east/north metres at surveyed LM. Original routes use spherical Transverse Mercator (radius 1,737,400 m, central meridian 30.7°, false easting 500,000 m, scale factor 1). Subtract the projected LM and rotate by local grid convergence. Decimal precision preserves source coordinates; it does not imply millimetre accuracy.

registration.note: Manual scale-bar registration describes only the historical overview. It is not fitted to the imported GIS; do not overlay those routes as though this were a controlled orthophoto.

map.accuracy: Reference image remains the low-resolution NASA-hosted overview. Routes and stations now use original USGS/Haase GIS, so small overlay differences are expected; image is not the geodetic authority.

boundary.rationale: Rounded construction envelope contains the traced completed traverses, near-base work and local station operating areas. Margin is a design allowance, not a historical limit. Distant mountains remain a separate non-playable backdrop.

gaps: Route geometry is original USGS/Haase GIS; underlying historical map includes approximate sections. Photo-derived station accuracy is much better than the full route corridor.

Panorama camera stations and instruments are now registered. The four chosen individual photos still require sequence matching to those camera stations; do not assign a nearby panorama location as an exact camera without evidence.

Local walking between individual instruments and within geology stations is not encoded as complete footstep trajectories. Original published endpoints and operating areas fit the boundary; no invented bootpath is presented.

The 2 m terrain product has a coverage gap roughly 2 km west of the LM, crossing both EVA 2 travel legs. The broader 5 m product encloses all mapped routes and the proposed boundary. Per-pixel confidence/NoDATA inspection and vertical alignment remain prerequisites.
Fender photo AS17-137-20979 belongs at Station 2, not the current near-base circle. Move the future photo encounter to Station 2 or choose a verified base-repair image; retain stable stop ID fender.

distanceAudit.note: GIS line sum 31.335 km differs from the published profile sum 31.204 km by about 0.4%; the older LRV odometer total is 35.9 km. Route generalization, local manoeuvres and possible wheel slip affect accounting. Preserve the distinct values; do not stretch geometry to match the odometer.

scaleRecommendation.status: Recommendation for prototype, not a runtime change or final pacing approval.

localOperations.status: areas reserved; detailed walked routes unregistered
localOperations.note: Surveyed flag, SEP, ALSEP/instruments, explosive charges and panorama stations are registered. Walked trajectories between these points are not inferred. Station operating radii are design allowances.

sourceArchive.note: Original GIS and text members extracted through HTTP byte ranges, then repacked with flat filenames. No terrain rasters downloaded. Route SHP contains nine components; DBF IDs are all zero, so EVA grouping follows endpoint continuity and the published map.
